label: LLM
description: AI language model completion: one call to a model, served by a wired provider node, with optional tool calling and a conversation kept in a file. For an agent that calls tools until it is done: run turns in a sequential Loop carrying the conversation file. Each turn takes the file on `historyFile` and the LLM Tools on `tools` (several through a List). When the model asks for tools, `toolCalls` pulses a List[ToolCall], each `{ id, name, arguments }` with `arguments` as raw JSON text; run them in a sequential Loop over `toolCalls` that carries the file, a Switch on the call's `name` (one `equals` case per tool) gating each tool's node, and add each result to the file with a Chat Message node (role tool). The file that loop hands back feeds the next turn, and the turns stop when one answers with no `toolCalls` pulse.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.description: Appended as the newest user message. Optional when `historyFile` is wired (a tool-result round re-enters with the conversation alone).

inputs.name: historyFile
inputs.description: The conversation so far, in a stored file (a previous call's or a Chat Message's `historyFile` output, or a file holding `[]` stored in the project scope to start one later runs continue). This call's turn is added to the same file, in place. Unwired, the call starts from no conversation.

inputs.name: media
inputs.description: One stored image, audio clip, or video attached to this prompt, or a list of them.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.description: Which service, model, and credential: wire an OpenRouter, Anthropic, OpenAI, or Custom Provider node's output. Never build this value by hand or pass it through a port typed JsonDict (a group that carries it declares the port as LlmProvider).

inputs.name: params
inputs.description: Optional LlmParams node (system prompt, temperature, ...). Unwired, the defaults apply.

inputs.name: tools
inputs.description: Tool declarations the model may call: one LLM Tool node's output, or a list of them.

inputs.name: toolChoice
inputs.label: Tool choice
inputs.description: Only used when tools are wired: auto lets the model decide, required forces a call, none forbids one.

inputs.name: parseJson
inputs.label: Parse JSON
inputs.description: Parse and repair JSON from the reply (output becomes a Dict). Declare output ports named after the JSON's keys (`-> (verdict: String, score: Number)`) and each key comes out on its own port.

inputs.name: autoCache
inputs.label: Automatic prompt caching
inputs.description: On: when the conversation carries no cache mark of its own, the request marks the system message and the last message before this turn. The marks are sent only, never written into `historyFile`.

outputs.name: response
outputs.description: The reply. Declare its type: `String` without parseJson; with parseJson read it only when something needs the whole object (`JsonDict` or a record type), and prefer one port per key.

outputs.name: historyFile
outputs.description: The `historyFile` that came in with this call's user message and reply added (same file, next version), or, when none came in, a new file holding this turn, kept past the run. Unwired with no file in, the call keeps nothing.

outputs.name: toolCalls
outputs.description: Pulses only when the model called tools. Append each result with a Chat Message (role tool) and wire its `historyFile` into the next call. A call left unanswered (the run stopped before its result was appended) is answered `cancelled` by the next call.

then.message: '{id}' declares output ports ({custom_outputs}) that only fire with parseJson: true; turn it on, or drop the ports and read `response`
